title: leadership_pac
description: One leadership PAC of a cycle, as the FEC's leadership PAC file lists it (from 2010), with its sponsor: the member of Congress or candidate who set it up. The sponsor's candidate id is fundlens's, by name or from a vendored list checked against the FEC's own records; the PAC's money stays its own, and is never a candidate's. A committee the FEC designates a leadership PAC (`committee.designation` D) that the file does not list has no row. Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

sponsor_name.description: The sponsor's name as the FEC's file gives it; where the file leaves it blank, the name fundlens's sponsor list gives; null when neither has one.

sponsor_candidate_id.description: The FEC candidate id of the sponsor, null when fundlens cannot tell it. By name, the one candidate of the cycle with the sponsor's last name and first given name; or from fundlens's sponsor list, which may name a candidate of another cycle.

sponsor_source.description: Where sponsor_candidate_id comes from: `rule`, the name match, or `list`, fundlens's sponsor list. Null when there is no id.
